test_title: PYST 4: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

The teacher gave the assignments to the students.

options.text: The students were given the assignments by the teacher.
The students are given the assignments.
The students had been given the assignments.
The teacher was given assignments to the students.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• Changing a sentence to passive voice involves making the object of the active sentence the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• **"The assignments"** is the object in the active sentence, so it becomes the subject in the passive voice.
 
• The verb **"gave"** changes to its past participle form** "were given"** in the passive voice.
 
• The prepositional phrase **"to the students" **remains intact but is placed after the verb in the passive voice.
 
• Hence, The correct passive voice form is **"The students were given the assignments by the teacher."**

Therefore, the correct answer is -** 'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Option 2:** This option is in passive voice but lacks the information about who gave the assignments, so it is incomplete.
 
• **Option 3:** This option is in passive voice but uses the past perfect tense "had been given," which implies a past action completed before another past action, which is not necessary in this context.
 
• **Option 4: **This option is grammatically incorrect as it suggests that the teacher was given assignments to the students, which doesn't make sense in the context of the original sentence.
